verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS compliance platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The Trust Center hide/display controls and the MCP auth details are different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
